question: Should Twilio RCS become a bundled OpenClaw channel despite the existing external channel-plugin path, or should it ship as a ClawHub code plugin with any generic core seam change reviewed separately?
rationale: Both placements are technically possible, but repository VISION.md prefers optional capability outside core while the bundled SMS precedent creates a legitimate product-tier question that automation cannot decide.

options.title: External plugin plus narrow core seam
options.body: Publish the RCS channel through ClawHub and submit only the generally useful HTTP-route ownership result as a separate core change if maintainers want it.

options.title: Sponsor bundled RCS
options.body: Accept permanent core ownership after live carrier proof, dependency authorization, fresh-install validation, and explicit upgrade handling for SMS route collisions.

recommendation.title: External plugin plus narrow core seam
recommendation.body: Publish the RCS channel through ClawHub and submit only the generally useful HTTP-route ownership result as a separate core change if maintainers want it.

likelyOwner.reason: The bundled SMS feature history and channel-tier precedent make this the strongest available product-direction owner.
